title: drive.ai Rainy Night Autonomous Drive
summary: Drive.ai shows its car driving fully autonomously on a rainy night in Mountain View, with heavy downpour, glare, a four-way stop and a broken traffic light.
why: Used in Who's Hiring posts as the company's demo and in self-driving threads as a notable bad-weather example.

quote.text: Here's Drive.ai demoing L4 in a downpour at night (really impressive)
